text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden. I build Python-based AI systems for internal Q&A and support workflows.

For a similar knowledge-heavy use case, I built a contract clause search assistant that answered questions over 9,000 contracts, quoted the exact clause and page, and improved clause lookup from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. I also built a delivery support chatbot that handled parcel tracking, rescheduling, and human handoff, with 43% of conversations resolved without an agent.

For your internal Q&A chatbot, I’d use Python with GPT-3 or an equivalent model, and structure it so your technical questions and answers are searchable, accurate, and easy to maintain. I’m comfortable with LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, and machine learning, and I can help design a practical solution for your organization’s data.
